Appointment, token and calling rules

Appointments can be booked after consultation at OPD reception, by WhatsApp message to 9869451768, or by email to pcro@tmc.gov.in for private and genopd@tmc.gov.in for general.

On the visit day, the token is issued 1 hour before the appointment. Tokens are called in sequence within their series, for example AF23 after AF22, and displayed with the room number.

SE ME AF RO

How days are selected

The app filters OPD days using the selected category, disease management group, and discipline. Only valid full-day or half-day options are shown to the patient.

✓ Full day ✓ Half day

Token and calling status

Your visit guidance

Carry the appointment slip or confirmation message at the entrance gate. Please avoid reaching OPD more than 1 hour before the appointment time to reduce waiting-area congestion.

WhatsApp booking is message-only. Do not make voice or video calls to the appointment number.
